icons.name: alarm bell check

icons.name: book download
icons.motion: Inside its circle the arrow winds up, drops out through the bottom, and a new one slides in from the top.

icons.name: shopping cart heart
icons.motion: The cart rolls back and returns, and the heart answers with a double beat.

icons.name: message lock
icons.motion: The shackle lifts and swings open on its left leg, holds, then clicks shut and the lock body jolts.

icons.name: iris scan search
icons.motion: The magnifier sweeps back and forth on its handle, scanning, and the eye blinks when the scan ends.

icons.name: video magic wand
icons.motion: The wand flicks and the star spins a full turn, shrinking slightly so it stays inside the canvas.
